old.d: Exposes all hidden and invisible enemies within 10 yards of the targeted area, and staves off magical darkness for 30 sec.
Wounds the target causing them to bleed for 147 damage over 21 sec.

changes.name: Vampiric Embrace
changes.old: Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 30 sec.
changes.new: Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 10% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 30 sec. You receive 100% increased healing on yourself from this effect.
